dispatch.pageDescription: Notification to users of the system
dispatch.customerDisabled: Customers cannot be messaged from here — the system does not find them by role (0 recipients).
dispatch.allHint: The message goes to every employee and market in the system.
dispatch.inAppAlways: Always on — the message is kept in the inbox
dispatch.telegramHint: With a market chosen — to that market's Telegram group; without one — to each recipient's personal Telegram (recipients who have not connected are skipped).
dispatch.title: Title
dispatch.groupKeyHint: Re-sending with this key creates no duplicate — the existing message is updated.
dispatch.confirmIrreversible: A sent message cannot be recalled.
dispatch.confirmBroadcast: Warning: the message goes to all users
dispatch.smsHint: SMS costs money and goes only to recipients with a phone. If there are more recipients than the SMS limit, the server refuses to send.
dispatch.lockedSent: The message has been sent — the form is locked. To write another one, press "New message".
dispatch.lockedUnknown: The outcome is unknown — the form is locked so the message is not sent twice.
dispatch.duplicateFailedText: The message was not sent again. To try once more, press "Send" in the form.

error.badRequest: The server rejected the request: check the recipients and channels (for example, more recipients than the SMS limit, or nobody found).
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to send messages.
error.notFound: Recipient not found — refresh the list and pick again.
error.conflict: This message is already being sent by another request. Check the result a bit later.
error.tooMany: Too many requests — try again a bit later.
error.server: Something went wrong on the server — try again a bit later.
error.generic: Could not send the message — try again a bit later.

breakdown.title: By channel
breakdown.label: Result by channel
breakdown.noteRealtime: Delivered to people with the app open — reading is not confirmed
breakdown.noteQueuedBot: Queued messages move to "Sent" or "Failed" once the bot sends them — the final result is on the "Sent messages" page
breakdown.noteQueuedProvider: Queued messages move to "Sent" or "Failed" once the provider delivers them — the final result is on the "Sent messages" page
breakdown.noteAllQueued: Everything is queued — the final result is on the "Sent messages" page
breakdown.noteNoProvider: The {{channel}} provider is not connected — {{channel}} was sent to nobody
breakdown.noteNoProviderSms: The SMS provider is not connected — no SMS was sent. Set it up: Notifications → SMS → Settings
breakdown.live: Live status — updates as {{channels}} are delivered

undelivered.title: Not delivered
undelivered.hint: Recipients who missed at least one channel · queued messages are not listed here
undelivered.errorText: The message was sent — only the list of undelivered recipients did not load. Try again or open "Sent messages".

result.title: Sending result
result.summaryInbox_one: The message was written to the Notifications inbox of {{value}} recipient.
result.summaryInbox_other: The message was written to the Notifications inbox of {{value}} recipients.
result.summaryInboxQueued_one: The message was written to the inbox of {{value}} recipient and handed to {{channels}}.
result.summaryInboxQueued_other: The message was written to the inboxes of {{value}} recipients and handed to {{channels}}.
result.tailQueuedUndelivered: {{channels}}: queued, while some recipients will not get them at all — see the list below.
result.tailUndelivered: Some recipients will not get the external channels — see the list below.
result.summaryInboxOnly: The message was written to the Notifications inbox only — no external channel went out.
result.summarySkipped: All recipients turned this notification off — it was written to nobody.
result.locked: The form is locked — this message will not be sent again.
result.duplicateText: This message was sent on a previous attempt — it was not sent again. The result is on the "Sent messages" page.

unknown.title: Unknown — check history
unknown.text: The server did not answer in time. The message may still have been sent, so it is not re-sent automatically.
unknown.runningText: This message is already being sent — it will not be sent again. Check the result on the "Sent messages" page.
unknown.step1: "Check history" — if the request reached the server, the message is there right away as "Sending" or with its result.
unknown.step2: If it is not in history — "Try again". The same request is sent again: if the message already went out, it will not go out twice.
unknown.step3: "New message" sends it as a different message — if the first one also went out, people get it twice.

detail.notFoundText: This message is not in history — the link may be out of date. Refresh the list and open it again.
detail.notFoundUnknownText: This request is not in history — it never reached the server. Close this window and press «Try again» on the card: the message is sent once with the same request.
detail.errorText: The server is not responding right now. Try again a bit later.
detail.undeliveredSummary_one: {{value}} recipient missed at least one channel
detail.undeliveredSummary_other: {{value}} recipients missed at least one channel
detail.runningSummary: Sending is not finished yet — the numbers keep changing
detail.failedSummary: The message was sent to nobody
detail.failedText: Something went wrong in the system — the message went to nobody. Send it again from the "Send message" page.

push.disabled: Notifications are off — they will no longer arrive on any device of your account.

push.disableFailed: Could not turn off notifications. Please try again.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser. To turn them on, allow them for this site in the browser settings.

push.explainNext: Next, the browser will ask for permission: tap “Allow”.
push.blockedTitle: Notifications are blocked in the browser
push.blockedBody: While the app is closed, notifications do not reach this device. To turn them on, allow them for this site in the browser settings.
push.enabledBody: News about new orders and important events arrives on this device — even when the app is closed.
push.enabledBodyShort: New notifications arrive on this device
push.deviceHintOn: Each device (phone, computer) is turned on separately
push.deviceHintBlocked: Cannot be turned on until the browser allows it
push.permissionGrantedHint: This browser allows the Elchi site to show notifications.
push.permissionDefaultHint: When you turn it on, a short explanation appears first, then the browser asks for permission — tap “Allow”.
push.permissionDeniedHint: Turned off for this site in the browser settings — turn it on with the steps below.

push.howToStep3: Reload the page and turn it on here.
